# Remove-ZbxHostGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Removes host groups.

## SYNTAX

```
Remove-ZbxHostGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHostGroup>[]> [-Force] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A host group is a named set of hosts; permissions, maintenance periods, actions and frontend views select hosts by their groups. The Remove-ZbxHostGroup cmdlet deletes the host groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with hostgroup.delete, all in one call when the pipeline ends. It asks for confirmation first unless -Confirm:$false or -Force is given, and -WhatIf lists what would be deleted. It writes nothing, and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Delete a host group by name

```powershell
Remove-ZbxHostGroup -InputObject 'Databases' -Confirm:$false
```

-InputObject takes a name, an id or a group object. ConfirmImpact is High, so PowerShell asks first unless -Confirm:$false is given. A group that is the only group of some host cannot be deleted (the API refuses).

### Example 2: Delete the groups a search finds, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Databases*' | Remove-ZbxHostGroup -WhatIf
Get-ZbxHostGroup -Name 'Databases*' | Remove-ZbxHostGroup -Confirm:$false
```

Get-ZbxHostGroup writes group objects; Remove-ZbxHostGroup binds each one. -WhatIf lists what would go.
